principle: Long, but never in one sitting. Five sessions of 20-30 minutes, each of which unlocks a visible part of the profile. Data quality drops sharply after ~30 minutes of continuous self-report, so splitting is a measurement decision, not just a UX one.

sessions.title: What draws you
sessions.unlocks: Interest radar (RIASEC) and top work values. Shown immediately: early payoff keeps people going.

sessions.title: How you operate
sessions.unlocks: Big Five + 30 facets + Honesty-Humility. Lane dispositions stay hidden until validated (pilot).

sessions.title: Reasoning I
sessions.unlocks: Nothing yet (ability results need both sessions).

sessions.title: Reasoning II and choices
sessions.unlocks: Reasoning profile (relative strengths), learning rate, risk and patience profile.

order_rationale: Interests first: enjoyable, low effort, immediate payoff.
Personality before abilities: ability tests are tiring and a failure experience can colour later self-ratings.
Cognitive sessions are separate and preceded by an environment check, because noise from a bad testing day is larger than most differences you want to detect.
Biodata last: by then the user trusts the product enough to answer factual history honestly.
minimum_viable_profile: If a user stops early: S1 + S2 already give interests, values and personality. Mark the Lane Map 'partial' and show which evidence is missing.
